name: Midway Barker

abilities.name: Aura of Authority
abilities.description: While in a 10-foot radius originating from the barker, the barker and its allies have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the barker is not incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The barker makes two attacks: one with its Brass-Tipped Cane and one with its Ballyhoo. It can replace one attack with a use of Crowd-Press Shove.

actions.name: Brass-Tipped Cane
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (7d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ballyhoo
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Crowd-Press Shove
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the barker and is knocked prone.

generation.userConcept: a carnival barker who talks you into standing still
generation.cite: composition after Hobgoblin Captain (CR 3: Aura of Authority + Greatsword/Longbow); the Bandit Captain's Parry is retired by the family sweep (2026-09-08: defenders carry no reactions)
